subtitle: Name That LLM exact-model passages: Kaggle Benchmarks + OpenRouter
description:
# NTL exact-identity gens v3

Reference passages for the Kaggle "Name That LLM" competition, each generated by an **exact model ID**. This dataset has two sources:

1. **b1 (free).** Generated through the **Kaggle Benchmarks Model Proxy** using free Benchmarks credits. Labels: claude-opus-4-8, claude-sonnet-5, gemini-3.8-flash, gpt-5.6-luna/sol/terra.
2. **or_paid (paid).** Generated through **OpenRouter (paid API)** with pinned model IDs, 1,055 prompts per label. **Total OpenRouter spend: $46.40** over 8,440 calls (see `SPEND.md`).

| label | OpenRouter id | upstream provider (OpenRouter `provider` field, rows) | $ |
|---|---|---|---|
| glm-5.3 | `z-ai/glm-5.3` | mixed OR hosts: Wafer 906, Decart 52, PrimeIntellect 36, InferenceNet 26, 12 others 35 | 0.29 |
| glm-5.3-flash | `z-ai/glm-5.3-flash` | mixed OR hosts: OpenInference 455, Wafer 377, Relace 112, InferenceNet 47, Together 24, 13 others 40 | 0.03 |
| kimi-k3 | `moonshotai/kimi-k3` | mixed OR hosts: Sail Research 410, Wafer 208, Fireworks 152, InferenceNet 102, Phala 76, 10 others 107 | 2.50 |
| gemini-3.7-flash | `google/gemini-3.7-flash` (fallbacks off) | Google 1055 | 5.69 |
| claude-fable-5 | `anthropic/claude-fable-5` | Anthropic 1055 | 16.15 |
| gpt-5.6-luna | `openai/gpt-5.6-luna` | OpenAI 1054, Azure 1 | 0.93 |
| gpt-5.6-terra | `openai/gpt-5.6-terra` | OpenAI 1054, Azure 1 | 5.84 |
| gpt-5.6-sol | `openai/gpt-5.6-sol` | OpenAI 1055 | 14.97 |
| **total** | | | **46.40** |

## Protocol
- **host**: user prompt only, with no system prompt, no temperature, provider defaults, and the length clause "(about N words)". Output is kept raw: rows with markdown or newlines are dropped, never rewritten. Tier `exact`.
- b1 also has **calm** (system "You are a helpful assistant.", temp 0.3 where accepted; tier `exact_calm`) and **mt2** (second turn "Rewrite that passage more concisely, keeping it one paragraph."; turn 2 is tier `exact_mt`).
- Every or_paid row is host mode. OpenRouter `reasoning.effort` follows the Oct 25 pilot: kimi-k3 `none`, gemini-3.7-flash `minimal`, glm `low`, and claude-fable-5 / gpt-5.6-* unset. A row was written only if the returned `model` matched the pinned ID. There were 0 mismatches.

## Post-filter (same for both sources)
1. The returned model ID must match the label's exact ID.
2. Rows with markdown or newlines, or outside 25-300 words, are dropped.
3. Host-leak: a row is dropped if its stopword TF-IDF cosine is >= 0.30 against any competition train passage.
4. Discriminator gate: a char 1-5-gram LinearSVC is trained on host train plus a reference pool. A (label, mode) cell passes if its family agreement is >= 0.85x and its exact agreement is >= 0.6x the SVC's held-out host accuracy for that label.

**Only `discriminator_pass == True` rows should enter training unions.**

## Files
- `b1.parquet` / `b1_pass.parquet`: the free b1 batch. 654 rows remain after steps 1-3, and 467 pass the gate.
- `or_paid.parquet` / `or_paid_pass.parquet`: the OpenRouter paid batch. 4,666 rows remain after steps 1-3, and 3,742 pass the gate. Ids are prefixed `g3or_`, so they never collide with b1 ids for the same prompt and label.
- `exact_pass_v3.parquet`: b1_pass plus or_paid_pass, 4,209 rows, with an extra `provider` column (`kaggle_benchmarks_free` / `openrouter_paid`).
- `SPEND.md`: per-label OpenRouter attempts, writes, rejects and $.

Columns: `id, prompt_id, text, model, source, setting, n_words, prompt_key, tier, discriminator_pass` (+ `provider` in the combined file).

## or_paid counts
| model | calls | $ | rows after 1-3 | discriminator_pass |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| glm-5.3 | 1055 | 0.29 | 487 | 487 |
| glm-5.3-flash | 1055 | 0.03 | 509 | 509 |
| kimi-k3 | 1055 | 2.50 | 695 | 695 |
| gemini-3.7-flash | 1055 | 5.69 | 372 | 0 (cell fails gate) |
| claude-fable-5 | 1055 | 16.15 | 552 | 0 (cell fails gate) |
| gpt-5.6-luna | 1055 | 0.93 | 745 | 745 |
| gpt-5.6-terra | 1055 | 5.84 | 696 | 696 |
| gpt-5.6-sol | 1055 | 14.97 | 610 | 610 |
| **total** | **8440** | **46.40** | **4666** | **3742** |

## exact_pass_v3 by provider
claude-opus-4-8 9 / 0, claude-sonnet-5 14 / 0, gemini-3.8-flash 63 / 0, glm-5.3 0 / 487, glm-5.3-flash 0 / 509, kimi-k3 0 / 695, gpt-5.6-luna 157 / 745, gpt-5.6-sol 95 / 610, gpt-5.6-terra 129 / 696 (free / paid).

## License
CC BY 4.0. Part of the prompt bank comes from the CC BY 4.0 `seyitkaangunes/ntl-extra-api-passages` prompt bank, which is credited here. The rest are NeuralLoot topics rendered through a host-style template. All passages are model outputs, generated via Kaggle Benchmarks (b1) and the OpenRouter paid API (or_paid).

## v4 update (2026-10-26): wave 2 + newline-join rescue
- **Wave 2 (OpenRouter, host mode, same protocol):** 2,113 new prompts (`prompts_v3b`, ids `b3_*`, from public CC/Apache Kaggle prompt lists; host-topic guard cos<.35) for glm-5.3, glm-5.3-flash and kimi-k3, plus 1,055 for claude-fable-5.
  - Spend: **+$19.80** (glm $0.66, glm-flash $0.05, kimi $3.54, fable $15.55).
  - **Cumulative OpenRouter spend: $66.21** of a $100 cap.
- **Join rescue:** dropping every output containing a newline biased survivors ~35% shorter than host (long answers are multi-paragraph).
  - Plain multi-paragraph prose (no markdown, lists, tables or code) is now kept with paragraphs joined by one space: `setting=host_join`, tier `exact_join`.
  - The gate is evaluated per label on host+join and on length-matched subsets. Every label passes, **including claude-fable-5** (exact .173 vs host .169, family .344 vs .359).
- **gemini-3.7-flash stays `discriminator_pass=False`:** OpenRouter outputs use em-dashes in 27% of rows vs 0.7% in host. That points to a route/model mismatch, not a filter artifact.
- **`or_paid_join.parquet`:** all 13,122 OpenRouter rows (wave 1 + 2) after steps 1-3 with host/host_join settings. 12,131 have `discriminator_pass`.
  - Passing rows (host / host_join): fable 1,049/721, glm 1,594/733, glm-flash 1,522/644, kimi 2,175/623, luna 749/275, sol 614/399, terra 700/333.
  - **This supersedes `or_paid*.parquet` for training.**
- **`pool_v8j_add.parquet`:** the 8,347 rows NeuralLoot adds on top of its union pool (deduped vs host train/test and the existing pool), with tier/w:
  - `exact_v3b` 1.0 (wave-2 host rows);
  - `exact_join` 1.0;
  - `exact_soft` 0.7 (fable).


## v5 update (2026-10-27): free b2 batch + sol b1 retry
- **b2 (free, Kaggle Benchmarks Model Proxy, same host/calm/mt2 protocol as b1):** prompts 200–399 of the v3 bank, generated Oct 26–27 2026 until the free Model Proxy quota ran out (403). Coverage is partial: gemini-3.8-flash 40/200 prompts, gpt-5.6-luna 104/200, gpt-5.6-terra 36/200, gpt-5.6-sol 28/200, claude-opus-4-8 78/200, claude-sonnet-5 200/200.
- `b2.parquet`: 266 rows after steps 1-3 (506 raw responses). `b2_pass.parquet`: 110 rows with `discriminator_pass` (gate re-run on the merged b2 data).
  - Passing: gemini-3.8-flash 23 (exact 18, exact_calm 2, exact_mt 3), gpt-5.6-luna 71 (exact 59, exact_calm 7, exact_mt 5), gpt-5.6-terra 16 (exact 16). claude-opus-4-8, claude-sonnet-5 and gpt-5.6-sol cells fail the gate in b2 (small cells for sol).
- `b1r_sol.parquet`: 7 gpt-5.6-sol rows (all `exact_calm`, all pass) retrying b1 prompts sol missed.
- No paid API was used for b2 or b1r_sol.

## v6 update (2026-10-29): b2 complete + sol b1 retry complete
- **b2 now covers all 200 prompts (200–399) for every label.** The b2s pass ran Oct 28 2026 on free Kaggle Benchmarks credits and finished without quota errors.
- `b2.parquet`: 686 rows after steps 1-3 (1,259 raw responses). `b2_pass.parquet`: 469 rows with `discriminator_pass` (gate re-run on the merged b2 + b2r + b2s data).
  - Passing: gemini-3.8-flash 107 (exact 90, exact_calm 6, exact_mt 11), gpt-5.6-luna 144 (exact 122, exact_calm 11, exact_mt 11), gpt-5.6-sol 104 (exact 87, exact_calm 17), gpt-5.6-terra 114 (exact 114). claude-opus-4-8 and claude-sonnet-5 cells still fail the gate; gpt-5.6-sol mt2 and gpt-5.6-terra calm/mt2 also fail.
- `b1r_sol.parquet`: 29 gpt-5.6-sol rows covering the b1 prompts sol had missed; 28 pass (exact 18, exact_calm 10).
- No paid API was used for b2 or b1r_sol.

## v7 update (2026-10-30): free b3 batch (prompts 400-1054, partial)
- **b3 (free, Kaggle Benchmarks Model Proxy, same host/calm/mt2 protocol as b1/b2):** prompts 400-1054 of the v3 bank, generated Oct 30 2026 from ~8:13 AM MDT until the free Model Proxy quota ran out (403) at ~8:45-9:05 AM MDT. Coverage is partial: gemini-3.8-flash 152/655 prompts (incl. 2 probe prompts), gpt-5.6-luna 320, gpt-5.6-terra 251, gpt-5.6-sol 231, claude-opus-4-8 316, claude-sonnet-5 341.
- `b3.parquet`: 891 rows after steps 1-3 (1,672 raw responses). `b3_pass.parquet`: 741 rows with `discriminator_pass`.
  - Passing: claude-sonnet-5 142 (exact 142; host cell passes the gate for the first time), gemini-3.8-flash 65 (exact 61, exact_mt 4), gpt-5.6-luna 237 (exact 189, exact_calm 33, exact_mt 15), gpt-5.6-sol 136 (exact 115, exact_calm 17, exact_mt 4), gpt-5.6-terra 161 (exact 144, exact_calm 17).
  - Failing cells (kept with `discriminator_pass=False`): all claude-opus-4-8 cells, claude-sonnet-5 calm/mt2, gemini-3.8-flash calm, gpt-5.6-terra mt2.
- No id or text overlap with b1/b1r_sol/b2. No paid API was used for b3.
